newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bank Austria issues 8 mln pref shares at 376 ATS.
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria issues 8 mln pref shares at 376 ATS.

text.p: Bank Austria said on Friday it would issue eight million preference shares at a price of 376 schillings each in a public tender from June 9-23 to raise three billion schillings in new equity capital.

Shareholders of Bank Austria, the nation's top bank, would be offered seven new shares for every 57 preference or common shares already held, the bank said in a statement published in Vienna daily Wiener Zeitung. The new shares are elegible for dividend payments from July 1st.
Holders of the bank's participation shares would be offered seven new participation certificates at a price of 329 schillings each for every 57 certificates already held, the bank added.
It did not detail how many new participation shares it would issue.
Bank Austria preference stock closed down eight schillings at 416 in Vienna trading on Thursday.

The bank in January acquired majority control of its closest competitor, Creditanstalt, for some 17 billion schillings to create Europe's 30th largest banking group in terms of assets. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
